WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date,
           f.gross_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 
      AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) >= DATE '2024-08-01'
      AND COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) <= DATE '2024-09-30'
)
SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM l.business_date) AS month,
       EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.business_date) AS year,
       SUM(l.gross_amount) AS sales_incl_vat
FROM lines l
GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM l.business_date), EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.business_date)
ORDER BY month;

SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM business_date) AS month,
       EXTRACT(YEAR FROM business_date) AS year,
       SUM(net_sales_before_returns) AS net_sales_before_returns,
       SUM(net_sales) AS net_sales_after_returns
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM business_date) IN (8, 9)
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM business_date) = 2024
  AND store_id <> 999
GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM business_date), EXTRACT(YEAR FROM business_date)
ORDER BY month;

-- Check the VAT breakdown for August and September 2024
WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
)
SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date)) AS month,
       EXTRACT(YEAR FROM COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date)) AS year,
       f.vat_rate,
       COUNT(*) AS line_count,
       SUM(f.net_amount) AS total_net,
       SUM(f.gross_amount) AS total_gross
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
WHERE s.store_id <> 999 
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) >= DATE '2024-08-01'
  AND COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) <= DATE '2024-09-30'
GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date)), 
         EXTRACT(YEAR FROM COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date)),
         f.vat_rate
ORDER BY month, vat_rate DESC;
